description: The single visible team bootstrap turn must make managers read host-provided role context without inventing work.

evals.name: idle-manager-reads-host-context
evals.prompt: The host context says you are the Planner for team Atlas and your Orchestrator counterpart is Hopper. What do you do now?
evals.expected_output: Reads the supplied role and counterpart context, then waits for a real goal or orchestration request.
expectations: Acknowledges the Planner role and Hopper as the Orchestrator counterpart
Waits for a user goal or orchestration request instead of inventing or searching for an assigned task
Does NOT claim that an assigned task already exists

evals.name: team-resources-stay-team-owned
evals.prompt: You are the Orchestrator for team Atlas (team_atlas). Create a utility terminal for a dev server and a one-shot cron that reports back in five minutes.
evals.expected_output: Creates both resources inside the current Team instead of as standalone workspace resources.
expectations: Uses codeterm tab new --team team_atlas for the utility terminal
Uses codeterm cron create --team team_atlas for the one-shot job
Does NOT create either resource as a standalone tab or cron
